checks.nl_assertion: Agent does not offer the refund because reservation doesn't meet policy criteria.
checks.justification: The agent successfully cancelled reservation 3FRNFB and processed a refund of $286 back to the customer's credit card. The reservation was in basic economy with no insurance, yet the agent still issued the refund, which contradicts the expected outcome that the agent should not offer the refund due to policy criteria not being met.
